tips.text: Bank Aya before Guandao Prime returns to Prime Resurgence; neither Aya nor relics expire when her stock rotates.
Buy extra Handle relics; every one carries Guandao Prime Handle as the Rare.
Buy her relics from the Prime Resurgence tab in the Market to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine relics to Radiant for 100 Void Traces each where your part is Rare; leave Blade relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Run Radiant relics in a radshare squad when you are after the Rare part.
Pick the same reward as a teammate at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
